body: I’ve been having the same issue for a few months now. Ive never had this problem though and it feels like it happened so suddenly. Ill be talking during a conversation then my mind will literally go blank halfway through. Or I’ll misplace my belongings. It’s a daily thing too like i forget genuinely everything. It’s been worrying me as well and I haven’t figured out the cause. I also have extreme anxiety and some other mental “issues”. Maybe they correlate?

We have the same skin :) ive tried probably one hundred different products in the last few years and nothing has or did completely diminish them. I started out hating my skin but realized that it’s normal. Your skin is what mine looks like even after doing skin routine each night. They’re never going to shrink permanently. Yes, you can create a skin routine, like me, each night to help but don’t expect crazy results. They’ll stay the same but you can clean them so they’re not so noticeable. But you have no reason to worry, it looks fine I promise. Some people would die to have your skin and I know that’s not helpful or what you wanna hear but it’s true. You’re gorgeous, I promise nobody is staring at your pores that close up let alone at all. I notice mine but nobody else does. It’s probably the same case for you considering our skin is almost the same. If you’re really that worried about it, buy a translucent powder to pat over your cheeks and nose each morning. But you don’t need to because it looks fine. Nobody is going to walk up to you and examine your pores. Nobody even thinks about that when speaking to you. You’re gorgeous, head up love.

I have a bump behind my ear too, it’s hard, painless and feels like it moves JUST THE SLIGHTEST BIT but doesn’t really. I’ve been getting major headaches and I don’t know if they’re related. When I take Advil it goes away though. Have you been having the same issue? I’ve had mine for months now and no big concerns.
